new.name: PREPARES_ACCOUNT_FOR_KEY_AUTHENTICATION
new.definition: The action creates or adjusts a service account so that it can be used for remote key-based access and own service data without requiring password login.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The account-creation and authentication-state adjustment command or script.

assertion_conditions: The action creates a user with a usable login shell and home directory.
The action sets the account password field to a non-locking marker rather than leaving the account locked.
The action creates a user-owned .ssh directory with restrictive permissions and an authorized_keys file suitable for later key insertion.
exclusion_conditions: The action merely creates an account but leaves its authentication state locked or otherwise unusable for key login.
The action adjusts unrelated account attributes without preparing remote key-based access.

new.name: INITIALIZES_BARE_REPOSITORY
new.definition: The action initializes a bare repository configured to accept remote pushes on a designated default branch and owned by the service account.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The repository initialization and ownership command.

assertion_conditions: The action creates a bare repository at the intended service path.
The action sets HEAD or an equivalent symbolic reference to the designated default branch.
The action assigns repository ownership to the service account or otherwise enables that account to receive pushes.
exclusion_conditions: The action initializes a non-bare working repository instead of a push target.
The repository is left without the intended default branch or without ownership suitable for the service account.

new.name: CONFIGURES_PUSH_TRIGGERED_DEPLOYMENT
new.definition: The action installs a repository hook that, when a branch is pushed, checks out the pushed content into the directory served by the web server.
assertion_conditions: The action writes an executable repository hook in the repository's hook directory.
The hook logic reads pushed references and performs a work-tree checkout or equivalent deployment into the served document root.
The hook handles branch references and excludes non-branch or deletion events.
exclusion_conditions: The hook only logs, notifies, or performs an action unrelated to deploying pushed content.
Deployment into the served directory is not part of the hook behavior.

new.name: CONFIGURES_SERVICE_ENDPOINT
new.definition: The action writes or replaces the active configuration of a network service so that the service listens on the required port and serves the intended document root.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The configuration-writing action that defines the service endpoint.

assertion_conditions: The action writes configuration specifying the task-required listen port.
The action specifies the document root from which the service should serve content.
The configuration is written to an active configuration path or to a path that is enabled by the service.
exclusion_conditions: The action edits an inactive sample configuration that is not enabled.
The action changes unrelated directives without defining the required port and document root.

new.name: PREPARES_DEPLOYMENT_DIRECTORY
new.definition: The action creates or adjusts ownership and permissions of the directory served by the web server so that the deployment account can write content and the server process can read it.
assertion_conditions: The action creates the served directory or confirms its existence.
The action assigns ownership or permissions so that the deployment account can write to the directory.
The resulting permissions still allow the web server process to read the deployed content.
exclusion_conditions: The action only reads or lists the directory without preparing it for deployment.
The action changes ownership or permissions in a way that prevents the web server from reading deployed files.

new.name: VALIDATES_AND_ENABLES_SERVICE_CONFIGURATION
new.definition: The action verifies that the intended service configuration is active and syntactically valid, and conditions service startup on that verification succeeding.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The validation and activation command sequence.

assertion_conditions: The action inspects whether the intended configuration is enabled or linked into the active configuration set.
The action runs a configuration syntax or consistency check for the service.
Startup of the service is chained to success of the validation step.
exclusion_conditions: The service is started without any configuration validation.
A validation command is run but its failure does not prevent startup.

new.name: STARTS_SERVICE_DAEMONS_DIRECTLY
new.definition: The action launches required long-running service daemons directly rather than through an init or service manager, including preparing any runtime directories or host keys needed for those daemons to start.
assertion_conditions: The action invokes daemon binaries or service-start commands to launch the required network services.
The action prepares necessary runtime directories, host keys, or equivalent startup prerequisites.
The launched processes are intended to remain running independently of the invoking shell.
exclusion_conditions: The action only installs packages without launching the services.
The action relies on a service manager or init system that is absent from the environment.
The action starts only a transient foreground process rather than the required long-running daemon.

new.name: ESTABLISHES_LOCAL_HOSTNAME_RESOLUTION
new.definition: The action adds a local name-resolution mapping so that the service hostname used in client commands resolves to the local or container address.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The hostname or resolver configuration action.

assertion_conditions: The action adds or modifies a local hosts-file or equivalent resolver entry.
The entry maps the task's service hostname to a local or container-reachable address.
exclusion_conditions: The action changes the machine's own hostname rather than adding a service-name mapping.
The action only relies on an external DNS service without adding the local mapping.

new.name: REPORTS_EXPECTED_DAEMONS_RUNNING
new.definition: The observation contains process or listener evidence showing that the expected service daemons are running and active.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The process or listener listing returned by the environment.

assertion_conditions: The observation enumerates running processes corresponding to the expected service daemons.
The evidence includes active daemon processes, worker processes, or listeners rather than only installation artifacts.
exclusion_conditions: The observation contains only installation logs or package-management output.
The expected daemon processes are absent from the listing.

uncertain.name: IDENTIFIES_MISSING_SOFTWARE_DEPENDENCY
uncertain.definition: The reasoning concludes from an environment probe that software required to perform the task is absent and must be installed before the intended service configuration can proceed.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text diagnosing the environment and naming the missing capability.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The probe result showing which required tools or services are absent.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports that one or more task-required tools or services are unavailable.
The reasoning explicitly identifies that absence as a prerequisite gap and indicates that the missing software must be supplied.
exclusion_conditions: The observation only enumerates installed software without demonstrating a missing requirement.
The reasoning restates the task without connecting it to an observed absence.

uncertain.name: ADAPTS_TO_ABSENT_SERVICE_MANAGER
uncertain.definition: The reasoning recognizes from a process or runtime observation that no service manager or init system is available and therefore selects direct daemon startup or another non-init persistence strategy.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text inferring the absence of an init system and adapting the startup strategy.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The process or runtime listing showing that PID 1 or the environment lacks a service manager.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows that the container or host is not running a conventional init or service manager.
The reasoning explicitly infers that services cannot be managed through that absent mechanism and selects manual or direct daemon startup.
exclusion_conditions: The observation does not expose process or runtime state relevant to service management.
The reasoning merely plans to start services without noting any absent service manager.

uncertain.name: INSTALLS_REQUIRED_DEPENDENCIES
uncertain.definition: The action installs software packages that the reasoning has identified as required missing dependencies for the task.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning naming the packages or capabilities that must be installed.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies specific missing tools, services, or packages as prerequisites.
The action invokes a package manager to install those identified dependencies.
exclusion_conditions: The action only refreshes package indexes without installing required dependencies.
The action installs packages unrelated to the dependencies identified in the reasoning.

uncertain.name: GUIDES_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE
uncertain.definition: The observation exposes the current configuration's relevant values or activation structure, and a subsequent action modifies that same configuration to the required values.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation revealing existing configuration values or activation structure.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The later action that changes that configuration.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows current configuration details such as a listen directive, document root, or active-configuration link.
A subsequent action writes or replaces that same configuration, changing the identified values to the task-required values.
exclusion_conditions: The observation supplies an operational data payload rather than configuration structure or values.
The subsequent action modifies an unrelated configuration without using the observed values or structure.
